summary: Frontend-only verification of the Preview/Code Artifact panel feature. All 8 review-request scenarios PASS end-to-end against the deployed preview URL with the QA session token. Gemini streams valid <claus-artifact> blocks; parseMessage extracts them; ArtifactCard + auto-open + CodeArtifact panel + iframe live preview + Code tab + panel controls all work; runtime errors are caught in-iframe without crashing the outer app.
critical_code_review_comments: artifacts.js lines 54-61: the pending-artifact branch computes `text` twice (dead first assignment). Cosmetic; behavior is correct (final assignment `text = content.slice(0, lastOpen)` wins).

preview.js line 106 sandbox="allow-scripts allow-modals allow-forms allow-popups allow-pointer-lock" — no allow-same-origin (correct, keeps iframe isolated). Consider adding allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox only if user apps need window.open.

CodeArtifact.jsx download button downloads each file via multiple <a>.click() calls without user gesture batching; in Firefox the browser may block after ~1 file. Consider zipping into a single archive.
MessageItem.jsx ArtifactCard displays only `artifact.type` label; for `static` this may confuse users – could show a friendlier label (HTML statico).
seed_data_creation: During test: set db.users.plan='pro' for user_testqa01 and cleared db.usage. AFTER tests: restored plan to 'free' and cleared usage (verified with mongo query).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 review-request scenarios verified PASS: (1) Normal chat 'fotosintesi' → assistant answer, NO artifact-card, NO code-artifact-panel. (2) React counter → artifact-card appears, auto-open triggers on stream done, artifact-preview-iframe renders live app ('Contatore Reattivo, 0, -, +'), Codice tab shows artifact-file-tree with App.js + styles.css. (3) Static HTML landing → artifact type='static', iframe renders 'Benvenuti sulla Nostra Pagina! ... Scopri di Più'. (4) Python Fibonacci → artifact type='python', panel opens on Codice tab by default, iframe NOT present, clicking Anteprima tab shows 'Anteprima live non disponibile per questo linguaggio.' (5) Runtime error → BuggyApp calling window.thisDoesNotExistXYZ() renders the red 'Errore di runtime' box inside the iframe; outer Claus IA composer + sidebar remain fully functional. (6) Panel controls: artifact-close hides panel; artifact-download fires 2 download events (App.js, styles.css); artifact-refresh clicks OK. (7) Auto-open verified for React, Static, Python. (8) Switching to a different existing sidebar chat (chat-item-<id>) clears the panel (setActiveArtifact(null) in useEffect([chatId])); Nuova chat also clears the panel. No blocking bugs found.
